text:
Alex: Quick sync — runtime removed `cache_ttl` from KV cache API in the last patch. That breaks sdk + api layers unless we add a compat shim. I have open PRs: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/234, github.com/redwood/api/pull/987, github.com/redwood/console/pull/412. Need reviewers and a canary plan. @Maya @Sam @Jorge please.

Maya: Saw this. I can add a tiny adapter in SDK to accept `cache_ttl` and map to `ttl` for now. Want me to open a PR?

Sam: I can review the API change today. Is the field actually removed (breaking) or just renamed? If removed, we need an API shim.

Alex: It's removed — runtime now expects `ttl` only. Leaving `cache_ttl` will 400. We should be backward-compatible for one release.

Jorge: Helm bump for console depends on the new api image tag. I'll gate chart merge until both sdk+api PRs are green. ETA?

Maya: I'll open sdk adapter PR in ~15m. It will be a tiny translation layer (accept cache_ttl -> set ttl).

CI Bot: [ci/circleci] sdk#234 — build started

Sam: If you can paste the minimal repro we can add an integration test in API to catch this. @Maya can you coordinate?

Alex: Repro snippet below:
```
# runtime request payload example
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "cache_ttl": 60,
  "input": "..."
}
# now runtime expects:
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "ttl": 60,
  "input": "..."
}
```

Maya: Adding integration test in sdk to post both keys and validate no 4xx. Will push test + PR in ~20m.

Sam: I'll prioritize api review once Maya's adapter is up. API needs 2 approvers per CODEOWNERS — tagging @Sam and @Jorge for review.

Jorge: Frontend/console requires the helm values schema bump, I'll draft a small helm-values PR that references the new image tag but will hold merge until CI green and both PRs merged. Also scheduling canary: I can run canary in staging and watch metrics for 30m.

Lina: FYI Dedicated merge window is at 16:00 PT — merges after 15:30 might get delayed by infra patching. If possible aim for earlier.

CI Bot: [ci/circleci] sdk#234 — build passed :white_check_mark:

Maya: sdk PR is up: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/235 (adapter + test). CI passing locally, pushing to CI now.

Sam: API PR updated to accept both fields and log a deprecation warning for `cache_ttl`. PTAL: github.com/redwood/api/pull/988. Running integration CI.

Jorge: Once CI green for sdk#235 and api#988 I'll deploy staging images, run helm upgrade --install on staging, smoke test, then canary for 30m. If stable, promote.

Alex: Sounds good. Can everyone react or reply when their PR is green? I can coordinate merge order: sdk -> api -> console helm -> canary.

Maya: :thumbsup: will ping when sdk CI is green.

Sam: Reviewing now. Expect to approve in ~45m.

Jorge: I'll standby for image tags, will not merge helm until you say go.

Lina: Thx — if you hit infra timing constraints I can hold the dedicated slot open for this merge window.

Alex: Great team. Ping here when all green and we can run the 30m staging watch. :shipit:
